method: Read every baseline-tracked blob from the working tree and recompute its Git SHA-1 blob identity; compare to git ls-tree at baseline. New files are outside these baseline counts.

testExecution.note: This audit does not rerun or claim unit, build, browser, archive-decode or visual verification. Those results are recorded separately by the task owner/evidence workflow.
